overview_description.description: Cytomate is the cybersecurity company that develops proprietary technology in-house. The company offers advanced solutions and services focused on offensive security, including Red Teaming, Penetration Testing, and Reverse Engineering. Its flagship product, Breach+, is a comprehensive Breach and Attack Simulation (BAS) platform that enables organizations to identify network security gaps and effectively prioritize security investments. By simulating a broad range of cyberattacks within a controlled environment, Breach+ supports organizations in safeguarding their assets and data while reducing their overall risk exposure.

about_short_description.short_description: Cytomate builds tools for simulating cyberattacks, red teaming, and penetration testing to detect and fix security risks.

product.name: Breach+
product.description: A tool that simulates and emulates a wide range of cyber-attacks to test and validate the effectiveness of existing security controls and assess organizational security posture.

product.name: Battle Twin
product.description: A virtual environment that simulates ICS/SCADA protocols to emulate cyber-attacks on operational technology environments.

product.name: Racid
product.description: A real-time monitoring system for digital assets that detects a wide range of threats to reduce risks of data breaches and operational downtime.

product.name: Sarab
product.description: A deception tool that misleads attackers by deploying decoy systems and false data, increasing attacker costs and recording their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

product.name: Red Teaming Services
product.description: Simulated cyber-attack exercises that test and evaluate an organization's security posture using frameworks like Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE ATT&CK.
